references.source: 大考中心 114學年度學測英文第11至15題，參照題型與考查觀念重新命題
references.design: 使用與現在事實相反的條件句，區分 would 與 will

question.q: If I ______ more free time, I would learn to play the violin.
question.exp: 與現在事實相反的假設用 If + 過去式搭配 would + 原形動詞。
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 大考中心 114學年度學測英文第11至15題，參照題型與考查觀念重新命題
references.design: 使用與現在事實相反的條件句，區分 would 與 will

question.q: If she were the club president, she ______ more reading events.
question.exp: if she were 表示與現在事實相反，主句應用 would organize。
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 自編高中課綱參考題（非歷屆試卷原題）
references.design: 過去反事實條件與被動語態結合

question.q: If the city had strengthened the riverbank last year, fewer houses ______ during the storm.
question.exp: 「去年原本可以做但沒做」是與過去事實相反的假設：If + had + p.p.，主句用 would have + p.p.；房屋是被淹，故用被動完成式 would have been flooded。
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 自編高中課綱參考題（非歷屆試卷原題）
references.design: 現在反事實條件句辨析

question.q: If I were in charge of the recycling project, I ______ the survey results before changing the rules.
question.exp: If I were 表示與現在事實相反，主句宜用 would + 原形動詞：would examine。
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 自編高中課綱參考題（非歷屆試卷原題）
references.design: wish 表達對已發生事情的遺憾

question.q: I wish I ______ the attachment more carefully before sending the email yesterday.
question.exp: 對昨天已發生的事表示後悔，用 wish + 過去完成式 had checked。
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 依高中課程觀念自編（非歷屆原題）
references.design: 文法搭配、語義條件與篇章改寫皆具單一最佳答案

question.q: If the bus had arrived ten minutes earlier yesterday, we ______ the opening speech.
question.exp: The if-clause uses the past perfect to describe an unreal situation in the past; the result takes 'would (not) have + past participle'.
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 依高中課程觀念自編（非歷屆原題）
references.design: 文法搭配、語義條件與篇章改寫皆具單一最佳答案

question.q: The safety inspection is overdue. It is high time we ______ the equipment before the next experiment.
question.exp: 'It is high time + subject + past-tense verb' expresses that an action should already be taking place, even though the meaning concerns the present or near future.
question.subject: 英文

references.source: 依高中課程觀念自編（非歷屆原題）
references.design: 文法搭配、語義條件與篇章改寫皆具單一最佳答案

question.q: I finished my report by the deadline only because you helped me yesterday. Without your help, I ______ it on time.
question.exp: This counterfactual refers to a completed past event: without the help, completion would not have been possible. 'Could not have + past participle' preserves that meaning.
question.subject: 英文
